text:
anna: Drafting the release notes for the docs site — focusing on SDK snippet sync, a short migration note, and a small known-issue callout. kicking off here.
kevin: thanks — can you paste the snippets that need updates? i can take the python client ones.
anna: main change: python SDK renamed Parameter -> RequestParam in v0.14. Example to replace:
```
# old
from redwood import Parameter
p = Parameter(text="hello")
```
becomes:
```
# new
from redwood import RequestParam
p = RequestParam(text="hello")
```
sam: got it. do we need a migration guide page, or just inline note in release notes?
lisa: i'd prefer a tiny migrate.md with 3 examples (py, js, go). link it from relnotes. makes it easier for search.
anna: agree. i'll draft migrate.md and a short anchor in the relnotes. kevin — can you update the python snippets in the "generation" and "chat" docs? file paths: docs/sdk/python/generation.md and docs/sdk/python/chat.md
kevin: on it. PRs will be #3627 (generation) and #3628 (chat).
docs-bot: PR #3627 opened by kevin — draft updates to python generation snippets.
marc: FYI — embedding streaming deprecation note should be included in relnotes too. customers using stream_embeddings need to migrate to embeddings.stream (breaking alias) — small code example and timeline.
anna: good catch. add that under "Breaking changes" with migration snippet and date.
sam: small known issue to call out: when using k-dim quantized models + long prefix caching we saw prompt truncation in internal tests (issue #488). not critical but must be visible in relnotes as "Known issues" with workaround: reduce prefix cache size or switch to non-quantized variant.
lisa: wording suggestion: "Known issue: rare prompt truncation with quantized models and prefix caching. Workaround: disable prefix caching for affected routes or pin to non-quantized model."
anna: will add that. also need link fixes: a few old anchor IDs got renamed during the last doc refactor. i found 3 broken links in js snippets page — i'll patch and include a note in the relnotes about updated anchors.
kevin: quick Q — do we need to bump the SDK version in code examples? some examples reference v0.13 in comments.
anna: yes, normalize to v0.14 across examples. add a one-liner at top: "Examples use SDK v0.14; update accordingly."
docs-bot: PR #3628 opened by kevin — python chat snippets updated.
marc: also: telemetry team flagged that telemetry keys shouldn't be in examples. we need to scrub any example that has api_key = "..." — use env var snippet instead.
sam: good catch. search results: 5 occurrences across docs; i'll run a grep and open a tiny patch PR.
kevin: will remove hardcoded keys in my PRs.
lisa: timeline? We have marketing copy freeze tomorrow EOD. can docs relnotes land before that?
anna: target to merge migrate.md + relnotes by today 6pm PT. kevin/sam: can you get PRs reviewed by 4pm PT?
kevin: yes, i'll ping eng-owners for review in 10m.
sam: i'll open the scrub PR in 15m.
docs-bot: PR #3630 opened by sam — scrub api_key occurrences.
marc: one more thing — please add a short "rollback" blurb: if customers need immediate revert we can route requests to the previous model alias (alias: stable-2026-02). add the exact command in relnotes.
anna: will add the command block.
kevin: quick snippet for environment var pattern to standardize:
```
# Recommended pattern
import os
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
```
lisa: looks good. i can help with copy polish after drafts land.
anna: thanks all — i'll push a first draft of relnotes + migrate.md, ping back here.
kevin: ack.
docs-bot: PR #3627 merged by kevin.
anna: merged migrate.md + relnotes draft, pushing minor edits now. last_message_ts=1763869200
